reviews.comment: Pointless and boring lectures, he spends most class deriving equations instead of doing examples, so lectures don't help at all with homework or exams. Common exams average around 65–70 (besides the first exam which was an 85-90), so you have to self-study hard. Do the homework seriously and attend for iClicker. Literally take anyone else instead
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he over explains concepts while never explaining how to apply them. he also spends way too much time deriving equations rather than showing how to use them. he's also pretty soft spoken so its hard to hear him a lot. every review session he had just led to more confusion since he didnt know what he was doing and overcomplicated everything.

Professor Cooperstein clearly understands physics, but his lectures were difficult to follow and he often spoke too quietly. Since this was his first year teaching, he seemed inexperienced in explaining concepts clearly. Most course policies and exams were standardized across sections, but I relied heavily on self-study to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Cooperstein is nice & understands the material but struggles to teach it clearly. Lectures are quiet and not very engaging, and slides lack enough practice problems. Quizzes and recitations come before topics are covered, so expect to self-teach. A lecture by Michael Youngs showed a clear difference in clarity.

It's a very difficult class especially if ur like me who didn't take physics in high school. He does iClicker but it's just attendance grade. Literal definition of a mid professor. Clearly knows what he talking about but hates teaching it. Also bro needs to get a better microphone he's hard to hear. Very introverted

You are mostly going to have to teach yourself. His lectures are not engaging and he makes you take a quiz on each chapter before he covers it in class to try to force you to read the textbook. He also tries to make attendance mandatory by doing iclicker questions every lecture. He is not the worst, but I reccomend taking a different professor.
